final_summary:
## 1. Sprint summary

- Built a deterministic Sprint 101 paper-only archetype ingestion bundle for 18 candidates.
- Reused Sprint 100 paper readiness state and preserved committee-owned architecture.

## 2. Why Sprint 101 was needed

- Sprint 100 closed paper-readiness warnings, while Sprint 101 safely converts the new 18-investor material into auditable archetype cards without enabling live agents, training, or runtime inference.

## 3. How the 18 investor material was applied

- Parsed local-only source material into candidate records.
- Normalized public philosophy into archetype cards, filtered unsafe claims, grouped styles, and mapped them into a paper-only roster plan.

## 4. Files added

- Added Sprint 101 examples, fixture data, docs, focused tests, and export surfaces for investor archetype ingestion.

## 5. Files changed

- Extended src/league/sprint98_committee_owned_core.rs, src/league/mod.rs, src/lib.rs, src/bin/soma_experiment.rs, and tests/support for Sprint 101.

## 6. Investor archetype ingestion

- Ingestion status: InvestorArchetypeCardsReady.
- Paper-only: true. Live activation forbidden: true.

## 7. Source confidence

- Source confidence status: SourceConfidenceReadyWithWarnings.
- High/medium/low/blocked = 15/3/0/0.

## 8. Safety normalization

- Safety normalization status: SafetyNormalizationReady.
- Removed impersonation/private-strategy/profit/private-life items = 36/18/18/18.

## 9. Feature vector cards

- Built 18 feature cards with entry, exit, risk, sizing, and no-trade conditions.

## 10. Do-not-learn guards

- Built 18 do-not-learn guards covering profit claims, lifestyle myths, unofficial quotes, private strategy claims, and unsupported rules.

## 11. Impersonation risk

- Impersonation status: ImpersonationRiskControlled.
- High/medium/low risk candidates = 0/18/0.

## 12. Unverified claim filtering

- Filter status: UnverifiedClaimsFiltered.
- Filtered 87 unverified items.

## 13. Private-life myth filtering

- Private-life filter status: PrivateLifeMythsFiltered.
- Removed 18 private-life myths while preserving 31 useful routines.

## 14. 18 investor candidate registry

- Registry status: EighteenCandidateRegistryReady.
- Short-term/long-term/crypto = 6/6/6.

## 15. Style group taxonomy

- Taxonomy status: StyleTaxonomyReady. Common risk members: CommonRiskManager.

## 16. Short-term / swing group

- Group status: ShortTermSwingGroupReady. Members: MinerviniVcpBreakout, OneilCanSlimMarketDirection, TurtleTrendSystem, PtjMacroAsymmetricRisk, RaschkeProcessManager, LarryWilliamsStatisticalSeasonality.

## 17. Long-term equity group

- Group status: LongTermEquityGroupReady. Members: BuffettQualityMoat, MungerErrorFilter, GrahamMarginOfSafety, LynchGarpConsumerGrowth, BogleLowCostCore, MarksCycleRiskPremium.

## 18. Crypto group

- Group status: CryptoGroupReadyWithWarnings. Members: WonyottiBtcRisk, SaylorTreasury, VitalikProtocolFundamental, BurniskeTokenValuation, HayesLiquidityDerivatives, WillyWooOnchainCycle.

## 19. Common risk manager

- Risk manager status: CommonRiskManagerReady. Risk Governor handoff required: true.

## 20. Style conflict matrix

- Conflict matrix status: ConflictMatrixReady. Conflicts tracked: 6.

## 21. Regime routing policy

- Routing status: RegimeRoutingReady. No-trade regimes: insufficient_evidence, cross_group_conflict_without_resolution.

## 22. Multi-expert committee topology

- Topology status: MultiExpertTopologyReady. Group heads: CommonRisk=CommonRiskManager, Crypto=VitalikProtocolFundamental, LongTermEquity=BuffettQualityMoat, ShortTermSwing=OneilCanSlimMarketDirection.

## 23. Confidence weight policy

- Policy status: ConfidenceWeightPolicyReady. Low-confidence cap = 0.55.

## 24. Feature scope mapping

- Feature scope status: FeatureScopeMappingReady. Overlapping features tracked: 10.

## 25. Learning data cards

- Learning card status: LearningDataCardsReady. Offline-study-only cards: 18.

## 26. Evidence requirement policy

- Evidence policy status: EvidenceRequirementPolicyReady. Minimum evidence before proposal = 2.

## 27. Archetype-to-member mapping

- Mapping status: ArchetypeMappingReady. Existing/watchlist/diagnostic/inactive = 8/4/3/3.

## 28. 18-member roster plan

- Roster status: RosterExpansionPlanReady. Active/watchlist/diagnostic/inactive = 8/4/3/3.

## 29. Activation gate

- Activation gate status: EighteenPaperRosterGateReadyWithWarnings. Live activation allowed: false.

## 30. Paper-only roster expansion gate

- Paper roster gate status: PaperRosterExpansionReady. Paper expansion allowed: true. Live expansion allowed: false.

## 31. Chairman style governance v2

- Governance status: ChairmanStyleGovernanceReady. Chairman can override Risk Governor: false.

## 32. Promotion/demotion policy v2

- Promotion policy status: PromotionPolicyV2Ready. Demotion triggers include impersonation risk, source-boundary violation, no-lookahead violation, and risk misalignment.

## 33. Safety coverage preservation v17

- Safety status: SafetyCoveragePreserved. Eighteen live activation forbidden: true.

## 34. Control Tower investor archetype panel

- Built a static/read-only panel with candidate rows, group rows, confidence summary, safety summary, roster summary, and explicit warnings for no train/runtime/live/order/account/browser controls.

## 35. Output bundle

- Wrote 32 bundle files to the Sprint 101 output bundle.

## 36. CLI and examples

- Added Sprint 101 ingestion/report commands plus example TOMLs for each view over the same safe config surface.

## 37. Tests added

- Added focused ingestion, safety, registry, routing, gate, panel, CLI safety, determinism, and config tests for Sprint 101.

## 38. Test results

- Focused Sprint 101 tests and CLI smoke are expected to run against deterministic local-only fixtures; full workspace acceptance remains a separate truth gate.

## 39. Registry status

- EighteenCandidateRegistryReady; low-confidence or blocked candidates = 0.

## 40. Safety normalization status

- SafetyNormalizationReady; warnings = 0.

## 41. Paper roster expansion status

- PaperRosterExpansionReady; roster expansion stays paper-only.

## 42. Runtime deferred status

- Runtime remains deferred; no model training, live inference, runtime LLM live decision path, live trading, broker, order, or account command was introduced.

## 43. Workspace acceptance truth status

- Workspace truth status: FullWorkspaceNotRun. Full workspace acceptance remains separate from focused Sprint 101 validation.

## 44. Risk review

- Chairman cannot bypass the Risk Governor. Risk Governor remains final veto. Promotion/demotion stays research roster management only.

## 45. Deferred items

- Runtime, training, live inference, live trading, Mamba runtime, Gated runtime, browser execution, dashboard serve, and any 18-live-agent activation remain deferred or forbidden.

## 46. Next gstack sprint recommendation

- Use the new archetype cards in a paper-only dry-run rotation, deepen evidence quality on lower-confidence candidates, and keep workspace acceptance truth separate.
